description: Discover services an AI agent can PAY FOR autonomously — cross-rail (x402, Nevermined card-delegation, Stripe ACP), curated (no coin-mint junk), and trust-scored. Returns payment endpoint, price, rail, and how-to-pay for each. Use when an agent needs to buy a capability (web search, scraping, data, compute) mid-task and must find a reputable, payable provider that works with its available rail.

capability.description: Coarse capability tag, e.g. web-search, web-scrape, onchain-data, market-data, browser-automation

intent.description: What the agent needs to buy, e.g. 'real-time web search'

maxUsdPrice.description: Max acceptable per-call price in USD

rail.description: Payment rail the agent's cardholder has authorized

name: stork_discover_payable_services
